note: The compile half of the memory pool (register decision 222). The CMake mutant stops the top-level targets compiling in the pool and is judged by memory_pool against the regenerated Ninja file; the script mutants switch off the compile check and are judged by its self-test and the real check. Since M1-109 (register decision 392) a Python mutant names no build target, and the harness builds nothing for it; until then every mutant named orbsim_shaders as a no-op, which made every shader an input of this file. A CMake mutant names build.ninja instead, which re-runs CMake when a CMake file changed and builds nothing else.
